blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday said individuals facing allegations should confront the issues against them and present evidence to clear their names, as questions over the status of former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque’s asylum application surfaced. On Tuesday, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla announced that Roque’s asylum application in Europe had been denied — a statement that Roque disputed several hours later.
